tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (--bg). The site is dark-first; light is the theme toggle. Never use #393a3e as a dark ground — that is light-mode ink.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Service cards, dropdown, mobile nav panel, founder image well (--surface).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Alternating 'raised' sections, the trust strip and the cards inside them.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for linked content cards.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks inside prose.

tokens.name: surface-closing
tokens.usage: Closing call-to-action band: a red-tinted ground.

tokens.name: header-bg
tokens.usage: Sticky header fill, under an 18px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default text on bg, surface and surface-raised (17.4:1 dark, 11.4:1 light).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Hero period, prose <strong>, the closing email link, button.secondary text.

tokens.name: text-soft
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and card CTAs (15.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: prose
tokens.usage: Long-form article and About body copy (12.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation links; hover goes to text-strong (dark) or red-text (light).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage:
Paragraphs: every

defaults to muted. 8.8:1 on bg dark, 6.9:1 light.

tokens.name: meta
tokens.usage: Uppercase card-meta labels above card titles.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Footer column eyebrows and the visual caption under the hero art.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Article index numbers and the footer legal line (6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: caption
tokens.usage: Hero location label (5.8:1 dark) — the dimmest text the site uses; go no lower.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: header and section borders, card-grid gutters, ruled lists. Borders, never shadows, separate things.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Heydru-Red: primary CTA fill, accent words in headings ("we step in."), arrows, status dot, process-step top rule. As text only at 24px+ in light (4.09:1 on white); 4.65:1 on bg dark.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red for small text: list numbers, section index, prose links, article eyebrow, current TOC item, light-mode hover. 9.1:1 dark, 6.7:1 light.

tokens.name: red-step
tokens.usage: Large outlined step numbers (01–04) in the process grid.

tokens.name: red-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button background on hover (on-red text stays 9.1:1).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on a red or red-hover fill — dark ink, not white (4.65:1 on red).

tokens.name: red-glow
tokens.usage: 4px halo ring around the status dot.

tokens.name: red-border
tokens.usage: Top and bottom border of the closing band.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Heydru-Azul. Declared on the site but used sparingly; never text on bg dark (2.3:1).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Focus ring in dark, skip-link fill, Drupal AI Engineering service art and hover border. Never text on white (1.2:1).

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: Architecture Advisory service art and hover border. Never text on white (1.4:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 6px on links (4px on buttons).

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: ::selection background.

tokens.name: selection-text
tokens.usage: ::selection text.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: When Drupal gets difficult, we step in.
styles.usage: Home hero H1 only: clamp(4rem, 7.6vw, 7.2rem); 9rem at 1600px+; clamp(3rem, 10.5vw, 5rem) under 760px.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Inner-page hero H1: clamp(3rem, 6.5vw, 6rem).

styles.name: closing
styles.sample: Talk directly to someone who's seen it before.
styles.usage: Closing CTA H2: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5rem); 2.6rem on mobile.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings: clamp(2.3rem, 4.5vw, 4.4rem); 2.2rem on mobile. Max width 780px.

styles.name: article-title
styles.usage: Article hero H1: clamp(2.4rem, 4.2vw, 4rem).

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: Process-grid step index, in red-step.

styles.name: article-row
styles.usage: Insight titles in the article list: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.9rem).

styles.name: service-title
styles.usage: Service card title.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Default H3 and prose H3.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Content-card titles (max 340px).

styles.name: list-title
styles.usage: Ruled-list item titles.

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Process-grid titles.

styles.name: proof-title
styles.usage: Proof-grid (capability) card titles.

styles.name: article-body
styles.sample: Most teams call us when something isn't working.
styles.usage: Insight article body, max 760px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Senior-led Drupal engineering for teams facing difficult platform problems.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a heading, max 650px; 1.02rem in the home hero.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Sometimes you need the right architect on the problem.
styles.usage: About and long-form prose, in prose color.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Base body text and text links.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button label.

styles.name: section-description
styles.sample: Most teams call us when a big decision is coming.
styles.usage: Paragraph beside a section heading, max 410px.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Availability line, header CTA, breadcrumbs, TOC links.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: You fix one thing and another part of the site stops working.
styles.usage: Content-card paragraph; process grid 0.84rem; service card 0.88rem.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Desktop nav and footer links.

styles.name: proof-body
styles.usage: Proof-grid card paragraph.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above headings, 24px below. Also card CTAs (no tracking).

styles.name: trust
styles.usage: Trust-strip items, each prefixed by a red ＋.

styles.name: index
styles.usage: Ruled-list and article-list numbers, in red-text.

styles.name: card-meta
styles.usage: Uppercase tag at the top of a card; also footer eyebrows and the legal line. 12px is the brand's minimum text size: never set text smaller.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Content max width: width min(1280px, 100% - 2 × gutter).

tokens.name: header-max
tokens.usage: Header inner max width.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter per side above 1100px (container is 100% − 112px).

tokens.name: gutter-tablet
tokens.usage: Side gutter at 1100px and below.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side gutter at 760px and below.

tokens.name: section-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of content, services, insights and closing sections.

tokens.name: section-y-mobile
tokens.usage: Section padding at 760px and below.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky header height (72px under 760px); scroll-padding-top is 100px.

tokens.name: heading-gap
tokens.usage: Section heading block to content.

tokens.name: eyebrow-gap
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Content-card padding (28px mobile, 25px in the proof grid).

tokens.name: service-pad
tokens.usage: Service-card padding: 28px top, 32px sides and bottom.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between service cards. Content cards use a 1px gap over the line color instead.

tokens.name: process-gap
tokens.usage: Process-grid column gap; also the actions row top margin.

tokens.name: actions-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a primary button and the text link beside it.

tokens.name: button-y
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (15px mobile); min-height 54px.

tokens.name: button-x
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (18px mobile).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, inputs, panels. The brand is square.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Only true circles: status dot, the motion toggle, the closing orbit.

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: Services dropdown only. Elsewhere, separate with line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-status
tokens.usage: Status-dot halo.

tokens.name: shadow-orbit
tokens.usage: Concentric glow of the closing-band orbit.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: width >= 1600px: hero H1 grows to 9rem.

tokens.name: bp-laptop
tokens.usage: width <= 1100px: tighter header, 3-column proof grid, 2-column process.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: width <= 1000px: article TOC collapses.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: width <= 760px: single column, mobile nav, smaller type.
